dedupe_keys.name: smartblades 2 finite element reference wind turbine blade model

description: Christian Willberg and colleagues publish this resource through Zenodo. The released finite-element blade model represents the 20 m SmartBlades blade tested on the NREL CART3 turbine. Native file descriptors identify Abaqus, Ansys and Nastran model inputs and archives containing comparison information. The source reports validation against experimental observations. This supplies a structural model for the named blade, not a general model of all rotor geometries. Experimental and simulated comparison components remain part of the same model package; no separate raw-data campaign is counted. Coverage is limited to the stated models, observations and application settings. Native metadata gives open access and the licence label cc-by-4.0. These terms describe the deposit; software and companion-data terms are distinguished where separately established. Only descriptive metadata and file descriptors were inspected; linked data, code and document bodies were not opened.
